report.answer_text: On March 19, 2025, the European Space Agency released Euclid’s first batch of survey data. It included three image mosaics previewing the telescope’s deep fields, where Euclid detected about 26 million galaxies in just one week of observations. The release also included shape classifications for more than 380,000 galaxies and about 500 potential gravitational lenses. (esa.int)
